description: Toy EWoK-style social-properties synthetic data pilot with behavior-grounded trait inference.
notes: This is a small prompt-quality and auditability pilot, not a full production pipeline.
Exact target trait labels are targeted at about 50% of kept examples: 50% implicit, 25% behavior-to-label, 25% label-to-behavior.
Traits must be inferred from behavior, not identity, appearance, accent, name, nationality, religion, gender, disability, class markers, family background, or neighborhood.
